title: Docking Computer
tagline: The original's famous moment: match the station's spin and fly through the slot, in green wireframe.
description: A Coriolis station turns ahead of you, and its slot turns with it. Roll to match it, steer to line up, and throttle down: through the slot under 110 m/s and you're docked. Too fast or off-angle and you scrape the face and lose shields. Ships leave the slot as you come in, and later stations are a Dodecahedron and an Ocellus, spinning faster. Lined up, the Blue Danube plays. Scored on time, speed at the slot and shields left.
